title: German Pepper Casserole
description: A hearty, flavorful German-inspired casserole filled with tender peppers and a rich, velvety sauce.
instructions: Slice the peppers and onion into large pieces.
In a large skillet, sauté the peppers and onion in a little bit of oil until tender.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the bechamel sauce and cook until heated through.
Cut the stale bread into small pieces and add to the skillet.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and top with additional bread pieces if desired.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
